components.name: SoftLK/SLK img2pixel
components.limitations: No repository code is incorporated; forge-art uses its own deterministic weighted-k-medoids implementation.

components.name: tiledpalettequant
components.limitations: No repository code is incorporated; no claim of derived implementation is made.

components.name: Pillow
components.role: runtime PNG decode/encode, deterministic route probes, evidence boards and indexed PNG encode
components.limitations: Pillow is I/O only; forge_art.vdp_color remains the sole colour authority.

components.name: ImageMagick
components.role: optional deterministic resampling backend for mechanical route shootouts
components.limitations: Outputs are mechanical geometry probes only; the backend never approves, quantizes or authors native sprite art.

components.name: OpenCV
components.role: optional deterministic resampling backend for mechanical route shootouts
components.limitations: Outputs are mechanical geometry probes only; missing OpenCV skips its routes without changing the source or claim ceiling.

components.name: GIMP
components.role: optional headless frontend for future curated GIMP-specific operations
components.limitations: Not a colour oracle, not required by forge-art convert, no production operation registered, GUI pointer automation forbidden.
